description: This file defines error types and functions related to registration errors, missing fields, and strict decoding errors within the Kubernetes runtime package.

classes.name: notRegisteredErr
classes.description: Error type indicating an unregistered resource or type in the scheme.

classes.name: missingKindErr
classes.description: Error indicating a missing 'Kind' field in an object.

classes.name: missingVersionErr
classes.description: Error indicating a missing 'apiVersion' field in an object.

classes.name: strictDecodingError
classes.description: Error type for strict decoding violations, containing multiple errors.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the error, customized per error type.

methods.name: Errors
methods.description: Returns the list of errors contained in a strictDecodingError.
